title: treatment bg values are silently used for calibration despite answering "no" or setting to "never"
symptom: xDrip uses treatment BG values for calibration even when the user answers 'No' to the prompt or sets the setting to 'Never'. The calibration is inserted into the queue and sent to the transmitter, which can cause sensors to be dangerously off.
cause: The thread does not explicitly identify the root cause, but it is confirmed as a bug by a maintainer who says 'I just tested and can see the problem' and plans to open a PR to fix it.
fix: The thread does not provide a fix, but a workaround is suggested: uncheck 'Automatic Calibration' in Settings -> Less common settings -> Advanced Calibration, and on the same page tap 'Use Treatment BG Values' and check 'Automatic mode'. The user also mentions avoiding entering BG values in xDrip and using the Dexcom device for calibration.
settings_changed: Use Treatment BG Values → Automatic mode
evidence_quote: I just tested and can see the problem. Thanks so much for reporting this. I will open a PR to fix this.
